newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's CANTV to consider dividend decision.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's CANTV to consider dividend decision.

text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV will consider Monday afternoon whether it will declare a dividend this year, CANTV president Gustavo Roosen said.
"The executive board will meet this afternoon to discuss if, when and how much it might pay dividends," Roosen told reporters after the company's annual general meeting.
Roosen did not say when the decision would be announced.
Company officials have repeatedly hinted CANTV may bring forward expected dividend payments to this year from 1998.
The company approved at its general meeting 208 billion bolivars in net profits for 1996, versus 32 billion bolivars the year before, all expressed in constant December 31, 1996 bolivars.
